decisions.rationale: Six days in with no project, no invite, and zero replies to both outreach emails (email:b42a2d62, email:4da345d9); no tickets filed, so no engagement signal at all. Three stall reasons at once and 8 days left make unaided self-activation unlikely.

draft.subject: A quick hand getting North Logistics started
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Checking in now that your Wrenfield workspace has been open a week. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating that first project is usually the step that makes everything else fall into place. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the first project with you live and answer anything about how your team works.

Best,
Chidi
